resources.string: Android is blocking notifications from Nyanime. Your titles can still update, but you will not receive release alerts or reminders. Enable notifications in Android settings; the yellow edges will disappear when access is restored.
Android has disabled one or more release notification categories. Re-enable them to receive new-release alerts and reminders. Your choices inside Nyanime stay unchanged.
Test reminder scheduled in one minute. You can leave the app.
Schedule a test alert in one minute to check background delivery.
Turn off alerts for a title without removing it from your library, agenda or trackers. Automatically followed titles include your library, tracked and started works.
Only explicitly followed titles send alerts. Turning on a title here also follows its releases.
No titles match. Titles appear here when you add, follow or start them.
Automatic following · silenced by your settings
Send release alerts only after you choose Follow. Your library, tracking and agenda stay unchanged.
Turn off both new-release alerts and scheduled reminders.
